scope: frontend auth provider transient state isolation

changes.change: Added resetAuthState() to clear user, set status to unauthenticated, abort pending session checks, and invalidate stale auth generations.
Initial /login render now starts with status=unauthenticated instead of checking.
Route changes abort pending frontend API requests and pending /auth/me session checks before stale responses can update auth state.
The /login route forces clean unauthenticated frontend auth state and prevents inherited checking state from dashboard navigation.

state_isolation.dashboard_state: requires authenticated provider state before protected subtree renders
state_isolation.pending_auth_me_on_navigation: aborted via AbortController and invalidated generation
state_isolation.stale_auth_me_response: ignored when generation changes or request is aborted
